name: MonarchBanner
title: Alert
summary: An inline message about the state of a screen or a section, with a tone, an optional title, icon and action.
whenToUse: For a status that stays visible until it is resolved: an error, a warning, a confirmation.
whenNotToUse: For a brief confirmation that disappears on its own use the Material 3 Snackbar. For a decision that blocks the flow use AlertDialog. For the status of one item use MonarchBadge.
api: @Composable fun MonarchBanner(message: String?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Info, title: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = { MonarchBannerToneIcon(tone) }, action: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, announcement: MonarchBannerAnnouncement = MonarchBannerAnnouncement.None)
enum class MonarchBannerAnnouncement { None, Polite, Assertive }

options.name: message
options.description: The message, one or two sentences; null for a banner that is only a title.

options.name: tone
options.description: Neutral, Info, Success, Warning or Danger.

options.name: title
options.description: A short summary above the message.

options.name: icon
options.description: The icon at the start, in the tone colour. By default the tone's icon, as on the web and iOS (info circle for neutral and info, check circle for success, warning triangle for warning and danger); null for none.

options.name: action
options.description: An action at the end, for example a small ghost MonarchButton.

states.name: default
states.description: Stays in the layout until the app removes it.

states.name: announced
states.description: A live region: TalkBack reads it when it appears or changes.

appearance: The tinted background and border of the tone with default text; the icon takes the strong color of the tone. The neutral banner sits on the subtle background.
platformNotes: Named MonarchBanner on Android and iOS, because Alert means a modal dialog on both platforms; the web calls it Alert. The tone icon is shown by default as on the web and iOS, from the glyphs Monarch bundles. One action slot instead of the web's list of actions.
accessibility: Title and message are one TalkBack element.
Polite or Assertive makes that element a live region.
The action stays a separate element with its own 48dp touch target.
The icon is at the start and the action at the end, following the layout direction.
Text wraps and the banner grows with the font size setting.
edgeCases: A banner that is on screen from the start should not be a live region.
With a wide action and a large font size the text column gets narrow; keep the action label short.
With icon = null the tone is carried by colour and text only; say the status in the text.
